title: Long Beach Sportfishing
specs: Targets a wide variety of fish species including yellowtail, bass, barracuda, rockfish, sheephead, whitefish, sculpin, Bluefin tuna, White Seabass
Licenses, rental rods, and tackle available for sale/rent at check-in
Private charters available from 6 anglers (6 pack boats) up to 40 anglers
includes: Fish cleaning services available on each boat (prices vary)
blurb: Guests fish for various species including yellowtail, bass, barracuda, rockfish, sheephead, and more. Trips include bait but licenses, rental rods, and tackle are available for purchase or rent at check-in. Boats have full galleys with food and drinks available for purchase; no outside food or alcohol allowed except on 6 pack boats.
extraNote: No ice chests, outside alcohol, or outside food or beverage allowed on boats except 6 pack boats · Boat crew gratuities are greatly appreciated · Boats are cash only; credit/debit cards accepted at landing for purchases before or after trip · $10 cash fuel surcharge due on boat for Full Day Catalina Island trip · Berth 55, Port of Long Beach, next to Berth 55 Seafoods
